changeinfo.changes: - Added ability to challenge a player from a ranking board to a game of Play By Mail. - Allow shoulder button to toggle lock camera position. - Option to toggle in game legal move highlights. - Country flags added to leaderboards. - Fixed a bug where the ELO stats for beaten opponents did not show up. - Fixed a bug where the system would crash when attempting to check mail after resending a Play by Mail game message. - Resolved a crash that would occur if the user rapidly switched between the options and audio volume screens.
